_comment: Does this ability actually WORK on a raid boss? Hand-tested, one entry per spell id. This is the only place that answer can live: db.exil.es carries no immunity data, so nothing derives it and nothing should guess it. Ability names are for the reader -- the spell id is the key.
_why: Most bosses are stun-immune, so a stun that says it 'interrupts non-player spellcasting' may do nothing on the target that matters. Some stuns DO land. Whether a given boss resists silence is likewise unknown. Only testing settles it, and an untested row must read as unknown rather than as a guess.
_values: yes = lands on bosses | no = immune | partial = some bosses, put which in note | omit the entry entirely for untested
_workflow: Add an entry, then re-run `python3 tools/utility_tables.py > notes/raid-utility.md`. The column is regenerated from here, so hand-editing the markdown is lost and editing this file is not.
